values.note: Every site has water and electric; 28 have 50-amp electric, water and sewer.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/camping ('Each site is paved and has individual water and electrical hookups'; '28 campsites have 50 amp electrical, water and sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 100 paved sites (72 water/electric, 28 full hookup); 50 take RVs up to 40 ft, the rest up to 35 ft; 8 pull-throughs. The park page calls 23 sites waterfront, the booking site 15. Primitive group area besides.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 72 campsites'; 'Full Hookup Sites ...: 28 campsites'; '50 sites can accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 35 feet. Eight sites are pull-through, while 23 are waterfront') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/campsites ('15 campsites are located on the waterfront'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/camping ('convenient to restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (Tackle Shop 803-482-6401). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lake-wateree/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); sites 15 -> 100 (the 15 was read from the AWH note's lakefront count; the park lists 100 sites), RVs to 40 ft, pull-throughs; added 50 A + water + sewer, 14-night max, showers and dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept (the park page says 23 waterfront sites, the booking site 15 as the note does). Not stated: season.
